bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to economic development; appropriating money for payments to bioindustrial facilities.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+APPROPRIATION; PAYMENTS TO BIOINDUSTRIAL FACILITIES. +]

[+(a) $15,000,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the Minnesota forward fund account in the climate and economic development fund to the commissioner of employment and economic development for payments to businesses that made private investments for land development, utility infrastructure, building, construction, and machinery and equipment purchases for the purpose of constructing and operating a bioindustrial facility to produce advanced biofuels, renewable chemicals, and biomass thermal energy or production that began before June 30, 2024. +]

[+(b) Beginning August 1, 2026, the commissioner of employment and economic development shall begin accepting applications for payments to existing bioindustrial facilities producing advanced biofuels, renewable chemicals, or biomass thermal energy. Payments shall be made to companies that received funding for incentive payments under Minnesota Statutes, section 41A.16, 41A.17, or 41A.18, prior to January 31, 2025. Applications for payments shall include copies of claims submitted under Minnesota Statutes, section 41A.16, 41A.17, or 41A.18. Payments shall be equal to the amount of any claim made on or before April 30, 2025, that has not been paid by May 15, 2025. This is a onetime appropriation and is available until July 1, 2027. +]

Sec. 2. [+CANCELLATION. +]

[+$15,000,000 of the fiscal year 2024 Minnesota forward fund account appropriation in Laws 2023, chapter 53, article 21, section 7, paragraph (b), is canceled. +]

A bill for an act relating to economic development; appropriating money for payments to bioindustrial facilities.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION; PAYMENTS TO BIOINDUSTRIAL FACILITIES.

(a) $15,000,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the Minnesota forward fund account in the climate and economic development fund to the commissioner of employment and economic development for payments to businesses that made private investments for land development, utility infrastructure, building, construction, and machinery and equipment purchases for the purpose of constructing and operating a bioindustrial facility to produce advanced biofuels, renewable chemicals, and biomass thermal energy or production that began before June 30, 2024.

(b) Beginning August 1, 2026, the commissioner of employment and economic development shall begin accepting applications for payments to existing bioindustrial facilities producing advanced biofuels, renewable chemicals, or biomass thermal energy. Payments shall be made to companies that received funding for incentive payments under Minnesota Statutes, section 41A.16, 41A.17, or 41A.18, prior to January 31, 2025. Applications for payments shall include copies of claims submitted under Minnesota Statutes, section 41A.16, 41A.17, or 41A.18. Payments shall be equal to the amount of any claim made on or before April 30, 2025, that has not been paid by May 15, 2025. This is a onetime appropriation and is available until July 1, 2027.

Sec. 2. CANCELLATION.

$15,000,000 of the fiscal year 2024 Minnesota forward fund account appropriation in Laws 2023, chapter 53, article 21, section 7, paragraph (b), is canceled.
additions: (a) $15,000,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the Minnesota forward fund account in the climate and economic development fund to the commissioner of employment and economic development for payments to businesses that made private investments for land development, utility infrastructure, building, construction, and machinery and equipment purchases for the purpose of constructing and operating a bioindustrial facility to produce advanced biofuels, renewable chemicals, and biomass thermal energy or production that began before June 30, 2024.

(b) Beginning August 1, 2026, the commissioner of employment and economic development shall begin accepting applications for payments to existing bioindustrial facilities producing advanced biofuels, renewable chemicals, or biomass thermal energy. Payments shall be made to companies that received funding for incentive payments under Minnesota Statutes, section 41A.16, 41A.17, or 41A.18, prior to January 31, 2025. Applications for payments shall include copies of claims submitted under Minnesota Statutes, section 41A.16, 41A.17, or 41A.18. Payments shall be equal to the amount of any claim made on or before April 30, 2025, that has not been paid by May 15, 2025. This is a onetime appropriation and is available until July 1, 2027.
$15,000,000 of the fiscal year 2024 Minnesota forward fund account appropriation in Laws 2023, chapter 53, article 21, section 7, paragraph (b), is canceled.
